title: Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector
alloyReason: UHP melted Grade 2 Ti (UNS R50400, interstitials <500 ppm O2) is specified for this gas delivery semiconductor component where metal contamination below 1e10 at/cm2 is mandatory. VAR+ESR double-melt reduces inclusions by 3 orders of magnitude. This rationale is driven by y-shaped forged gas splitting connector and fat life requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for gas delivery geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse for net-shape tolerance
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for yshaped forged gas application
commonFailures: Virtual leak from dead-leg threaded connections - remedied by VCR/Swagelok face-seal fittings — critical for yshaped forged gas performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector suitable for Y-shaped forged gas splitting connector?
faq.a: Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address gas delivery operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for yshaped forged gas requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. yshaped forged gas components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for yshaped forged gas application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Gas Y-Splitter Connector includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet yshaped forged gas specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Y-connector / Splitter gas delivery components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
